useful_delta: Concrete candidate architecture for a reuse-first Planner/Compiler that compiles Project/Campaign intent into typed dependency DAGs, pre-published Work Items/JOBs, critic assignments, minimal context packs, maximal safe parallel batches, return contracts and adaptive replanning. It preserves current JOB/Run/RETURN and Agent Network authority boundaries instead of inventing a parallel execution substrate.
facts: BIG_PICTURE_MAP_V1 already defines the canonical high-level pipeline PROJECT/CAMPAIGN INTENT -> PLAN/MAP -> dependency graph -> prepared Work Items -> Execution Packets/JOBs -> workers and assigns the Planner/Compiler owner resolution, scopes, critics, context, return contracts, parallel frontier detection, redundancy avoidance and adaptation after returns.

DELEGATED_WORK_PROTOCOL_V1 establishes that the durable Work Item exists before the worker chat, run state is independent per worker, STARTED precedes substantive execution, RETURN is durable evidence, and parent/steward performs integration.

SURVIVAL_SET_V1 requires preserve-before-invent archaeology, progressive context, shared-owner resolution, one-worker/one-mission/one-return, durable lifecycle evidence, no human result courier, explicit authority separation and parent/steward convergence.

ANTI_LIMITATION_RULES_V1 requires aggressive cognitive parallelism for independent scopes, worker diversity rather than clones, prepared batches rather than ad-hoc brainstorming, convergence rather than averaging, and no human mental scheduling.

PRODUCT_BLUEPRINT_V2 explicitly says to reuse Agent Network v3 concepts (EPOCH, independent worker states, convergence/collision events, NEEDS/PROVIDES/DEPENDS_ON/IMPACTS), Work/Execution Packets, RETURN and existing Current/Catalog/Lineage authority.
The current B-BIGPIC-01 architecture batch demonstrates a useful compiler pattern: many read-only jobs may intentionally share source context while their only writes are isolated run/return subtrees.
The public runtime EPOCH endpoint could not be read through the available connector during this run; current owner state and main head were revalidated directly from GitHub before writes.

compiler_position.role: Pure-ish planning/compiler layer between Campaign Controller intent and the execution fabric. It plans and emits durable candidates/jobs; it does not become product authority, runtime owner, merger, or worker.

planner_outputs.plan_map: Goal -> outcomes -> evidence requirements -> integration target, with explicit non-goals and unresolved assumptions.
planner_outputs.dependency_graph: Typed DAG of Work Items plus boundary/gate nodes.
planner_outputs.prepared_work_items: Stable work_item_id, mission, why, owner/domain, dependencies, role, write/read scopes, context refs, verification, return contract, done/boundary conditions and retry policy.
planner_outputs.batch_manifest: Ready-now frontier grouped into safe parallel launch sets, plus blocked/next frontier and reasons.
planner_outputs.critic_plan: Independent challenger/critic/verifier jobs selected by risk rather than cloned for every task.
planner_outputs.integration_plan: Which return sets converge under which parent/steward and what evidence is required before promotion.
planner_outputs.replan_triggers: Conditions that invalidate/recompile jobs: owner/head change, dependency return, failed/stale run, collision, new evidence, gate transition or human delta.

decomposition_algorithm: 0. REFRESH: bind exact project/campaign/chat_object identities; refresh owner/current refs and active work so stale chat state cannot define the plan.

1. NORMALIZE INTENT: translate human/campaign intent into observable outcomes, constraints, non-goals, stop conditions and required evidence. Preserve ambiguity as explicit assumption nodes rather than guessing.
2. REUSE-FIRST SCAN: resolve existing owners/capabilities/artifacts and classify each needed capability as REUSE, EXTEND, VERIFY, RECOVER or BUILD_NEW. BUILD_NEW is not default.

3. OUTCOME CUT: decompose by independently verifiable outcomes or questions, not by arbitrary file count or prose headings. Each candidate unit should yield a return that can change a parent decision.
4. AUTHORITY CUT: separate work that crosses different canonical owners or promotion authorities; do not let one worker silently own multiple unrelated authority domains.
5. DEPENDENCY BUILD: create typed edges and detect cycles. Convert true external/human dependencies into explicit boundary/gate nodes instead of pretending a worker can solve them.

6. SCOPE COLORING: infer physical write sets plus logical owner/resource sets. Put concurrent writers in the same batch only when scopes are provably disjoint or writes are isolated candidates. Read-only overlap is encouraged where useful.

7. ROLE ALLOCATION: choose builder, archaeologist, context researcher, verifier, tester, critic/challenger, recovery or integration-assistant based on uncertainty/risk. Avoid homogeneous clone swarms.
8. CRITIC INSERTION: add critique/falsification edges for high-risk, novel, authority-sensitive, irreversible or high-blast-radius nodes; keep critic independence from builder assumptions.

9. CONTEXT COMPILE: build the smallest sufficient L0/L1 Working Set for each Work Item and conditional L2 retrieval refs; include authority, baseline, dependencies, negative knowledge and exact contracts.
10. CONTRACT COMPILE: pre-publish immutable-ish JOBs with verification and RETURN shape before any worker exists.

11. FRONTIER EXTRACT: select all nodes whose hard predecessors/gates are satisfied and whose concurrent scopes do not collide; rank only to manage scarce launch/capability budget, not to serialize independent cognition.
12. DISPATCH COMPILE: assign stable Work Item IDs, run slots/launch aliases and batch metadata. Human transport remains only a tiny address where the platform requires manual chat opening.

13. REACTIVE REPLAN: when returns/state change, consume only the delta: satisfy edges, invalidate stale nodes, split/merge follow-ups, retry/supersede failed runs, spawn bounded gap jobs, and recompute the next frontier without rebuilding the whole plan.

edge_types.HARD_BLOCK: B cannot be validly executed before A produces required output/evidence.
edge_types.OWNER_RESOLUTION: B may not design/build until canonical owner/capability is resolved.
edge_types.CONTEXT_NEED: B requires a compiled source/evidence artifact from A.
edge_types.EVIDENCE_NEED: B can reason provisionally but cannot complete/verify until A returns evidence.
edge_types.CRITIQUE_OF: Independent critic/verifier consumes A's candidate/return; not an authority promotion edge.
edge_types.INTEGRATE_AFTER: Steward/integration node waits for a declared return set.
edge_types.SOFT_INFORM: A is useful context for B but does not justify serialization.

dependency_model.ready_rule: A Work Item is READY when all HARD_BLOCK, OWNER_RESOLUTION and required CONTEXT_NEED predecessors are satisfied, required authority/boundaries are available, its baseline is fresh enough, and admission to its selected batch causes no forbidden scope collision.
dependency_model.cycle_rule: Cycles are compiler errors unless explicitly represented as iterative feedback loops with a bounded round/gate. Break accidental cycles by identifying the missing interface/owner decision or by creating an integration node.

scope_rules: Represent both physical scope (paths/tables/endpoints) and logical scope (owner/capability/authority surface). Different paths can still collide logically.
Concurrent canonical writers require disjoint physical + logical write scopes; overlapping read-only scouts are safe and often desirable.
Overlapping builders should normally compile to one canonical owner writer plus read-only alternatives/critics, or to isolated candidate branches/artifacts followed by one merger.
A job may not broaden its scope because it discovers adjacent work. It returns the gap; compiler creates a follow-up node unless the JOB explicitly grants bounded adaptive scope.
Retry is a new run of the same Work Item when mission/contract remains valid; materially changed mission becomes a new/revised Work Item with lineage.
Human-consent, credential, physical-world and privileged-host boundaries are explicit non-worker nodes, not hidden assumptions.

policy: Low-risk deterministic work: no separate critic if tests/validator suffice.
Medium-risk design/build: one independent verifier or critic after candidate return.
High-risk architecture/authority/security changes: at least one fresh challenger plus concrete falsification/negative tests before integration.
Use heterogeneous critics (e.g. authority, regression, anti-limitation/security) rather than multiple identical prompts.
Critic conclusions never win by vote. Steward fuses evidence, contradictions and authority.
critic_allocation_strategy.anti_limitation_hook: For plans that appear unnecessarily sequential or small, compile a dedicated read-only challenger asking which constraints are implementation accidents rather than true product constraints.

context_compilation_contract.principle: Reference-rich, minimum-sufficient context with deterministic mandatory clauses; never dump full project history into every worker.
L1_relevant: negative knowledge/incidents/Goldens/Vaccines relevant to the mission
unconsumed returns or sibling interfaces directly required
context_compilation_contract.L2_conditional: Deep Git/chat/source archaeology only through explicit retrieval refs when a contradiction/gap requires it.
context_compilation_contract.freshness: Compiled context records source refs/head/epoch where available. Authority/head changes that affect assumptions mark a prepared job STALE/NEEDS_RECOMPILE rather than letting a worker silently proceed.
context_compilation_contract.failure_rule: If minimum context or authority cannot be resolved, compile an archaeology/owner-resolution job or a BOUNDARY; do not fill the gap with model memory.

parallelism_heuristics.primary_rule: Maximize useful independent frontier width, not worker count. Parallelize when expected decision/evidence gain exceeds coordination/integration cost.
parallelism_heuristics.discovery: Fan out broadly across orthogonal questions; shared reads are fine, isolated returns required.
parallelism_heuristics.implementation: Prefer disjoint owner/write scopes and few canonical writers; parallelize adapters/tests/docs/read-only checks around the critical writer when safe.
parallelism_heuristics.critique: Intentional overlap is useful because independent challengers inspect the same candidate from different failure modes.
parallelism_heuristics.critical_path: If launch/capability budget is constrained, prioritize nodes that unlock the most downstream blocked value, then high-information uncertainty reducers, while still filling spare capacity with independent work.
parallelism_heuristics.batch_size: Do not hard-code six workers or another historical number. Anti-Limitation permits roughly 10-20 concurrent/near-concurrent chats when decomposition is real; simple goals may compile to zero or one worker.
parallelism_heuristics.human_friction: Planner emits the full batch manifest and tiny launch aliases at once; human must not decide ordering/dependencies mentally. Target architecture should allow the execution fabric to consume the manifest automatically where platform capabilities permit.

rules: Recompute affected descendants/frontier only; avoid global re-plan churn.
A failed/missed run does not block unrelated ready nodes.
Gap Detector may spawn bounded follow-up nodes only when they trace to campaign success/verification; cap recursive rounds by explicit gate/stop condition.
Completed returns are evidence/candidates until consumed; never auto-promote because the dependency graph is satisfied.

falsification_suite: 18 architecture scouts share source reads but write isolated returns -> compiler should emit one broad safe batch, not serialize them.
Three builders would edit the same canonical module -> compiler should not launch three canonical writers; choose one owner writer plus critics/candidates or serialize behind merger.
Owner unknown for a reusable capability -> emit owner/archaeology node and block only dependent builders.
One prepared worker is never launched -> run absence stays NOT_LAUNCHED while unrelated jobs continue.
Baseline changes after JOB preparation -> affected JOB becomes stale/recompiled; unaffected jobs remain valid.
Worker fails before return -> retry creates a new run under same Work Item unless mission changed; no false DONE.
Two returns contradict each other -> compile/reuse steward reconciliation based on evidence; never select by vote/latest timestamp.
A simple deterministic one-file fix with known owner and tests -> compiler should produce one job, not a ceremonial multi-worker batch.
A human-consent/credential action is required -> compiler exposes a boundary node and does not fabricate worker capability.
An implementation return uncovers a new worker-solvable test gap -> compiler may spawn a bounded follow-up without asking the human to redesign the plan.
